ABOUT ME

I build immersive systems to study how people understand technology.

My work sits between HCI research, XR prototyping, and data-driven evaluation. I am interested in how people follow guidance, make sense of digital information, and stay in control when technology becomes more adaptive, immersive, or AI-supported.

In my master's thesis with KTH, AstraZeneca, and Digital Futures, I designed and evaluated a VR-simulated AR training system for industrial maintenance. That project shaped how I work: I like turning research questions into working prototypes, testing them with real users, and using the results to improve the design.

Before moving deeper into HCI/XR research, I worked for several years in reporting, data analysis, and IT support. That background still influences me. I care about systems that are not only technically functional, but also understandable, usable, and meaningful for the people who depend on them.

Research & Discovery

Understanding the problem, the users, and the context — including accessibility and inclusion — before building. I work with literature, stakeholder needs, interviews, surveys, and formative studies to frame what the system should actually support.

User research Stakeholder needs Participatory design

Interaction & Experience Design

Designing interfaces and interactions that make complex systems easier to understand, use, and evaluate — from immersive AR guidance to dashboards and app flows.

Interaction design UI/UX Immersive guidance

Prototyping & Development

Building working prototypes that can be tested with real users, using Unity/C#, Python/FastAPI, sensor-based interaction, and data-driven systems.

Unity / C# Python / FastAPI XR prototyping

Evaluation & Data

Testing systems with users and turning results into design insight through questionnaires, qualitative analysis, task-performance data, and reporting.

MASTER’S THESIS
STOCKHOLM UNIVERSITY · 2025

Enhancing Industrial Training through Situated Visualization in AR

2D — Video Guidance
3D — Ghost-Hand Guidance

MASTER'S THESIS — Conducted in collaboration with KTH, AstraZeneca, and Digital Futures. Compared 2D video with 3D ghost-hand situated guidance in a VR-simulated AR training environment. I built the Unity prototype for Meta Quest Pro and evaluated the two designs using SUS, NASA-TLX, SSQ, task completion time, and delayed recall.

The work led to three peer-reviewed publications, including a design-and-evaluation paper, a participatory design case study, and a scoping review.

Graded Excellent — top grade on Sweden's five-point scale

STOCKHOLM UNIVERSITY · 2024

SoulSphere

A guided MR calming experience that combined immersive narration, hand-tracked interaction, and tangible feedback. Users shaped a virtual energy ball with their hands while moving from passthrough into a fully immersive VR environment, supported by heat and haptic feedback from physical wearable/tangible devices.

MY ROLE

Interaction Designer & XR Developer. Contributed to interaction design, immersion, tangible device design, Unity development, and multisensory feedback, including hand tracking, heat, haptic feedback, and guided narration.

VR Steering Interaction Study
